title: Kale, tomato and lemon one-pot spaghetti

source.title: Kale, Tomato and Lemon Magic One-Pot Spaghetti by Anna Jones

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.amount: to serve, optional, or a vegan equivalent

instructions: Boil a kettle. Halve the tomatoes, zest the lemons, and strip the tough stalks from the kale and tear the leaves.
Put the pasta in a large shallow pan with a lid, add the tomatoes, lemon zest, oil and salt. Pour in 1 litre of boiling water, cover and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, take the lid off and simmer on a high heat for 6 minutes, turning the pasta with tongs every 30 seconds or so.
Add the kale and cook for 2 more minutes, until almost all the water has evaporated. Take off the heat, divide between four bowls and top with a little Parmesan.
